faithfulness.windows: random real windows (seed 7) from the pipeline sessions
faithfulness.llm_note: no language model configured here (set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or run Ollama); not measured

guardrail.method: mock model that always states a pulse of 142 and a drop of 37%, which are in no summary

retrieval.caveat: query expansion terms were tuned after seeing misses on these questions: optimistic, not held-out

cost_and_speed.language_model_delay_note: not measured: no language model configured in this run
cost_and_speed.note: cost per call = tokens x the chosen model's price; prices are not hard-coded here

ablation.note: readability and length are proxies. Clarity and helpfulness ratings from people are still to be collected (13.4).

usefulness.how: give usefulness_rating_sheet.csv to 3-5 people, then run python -m ml.dataset_pipeline.aggregate_ratings
